title: Novel GPER Agonist, CITFA, Increases Neurite Growth in Rat Embryonic (E18) Hippocampal Neurons.
authors: DeLeon, Chelsea; Pemberton, Kyle; Green, Michael; Kalajdzic, Vanja; Rosato, Martina; Xu, Fenglian; Arnatt, Christopher
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型GPER激动剂CITFA促进神经元突起生长，核心是G蛋白偶联受体-小分子配体互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合体系无关，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Numerous studies have reported neuroprotective and procognitive effects of estrogens. The estrogen 17beta-estradiol (E2) activates both the classical nuclear estrogen receptors ERalpha and ERbeta as well as the G protein-coupled estrogen receptor (GPER). The differential effects of targeting the classical estrogen receptors over GPER are not well-understood. A limited number of selective GPER compounds have been described. In this study, 10 novel compounds were synthesized and exhibited half-maximal effective concentration values greater than the known GPER agonist G-1 in calcium mobilization assays performed in nonadherent HL-60 cells. Of these compounds, 2-cyclohexyl-4-isopropyl-N-((5-(tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-yl)furan-2-yl)methyl)aniline, referred to as CITFA, significantly increased axonal and dendritic growth in neurons extracted from embryonic day 18 (E18) fetal rat hippocampal neurons. Confirmation of the results was performed by treating E18 hippocampal neurons with known GPER-selective antagonist G-36 and challenging with either E2, G-1, or CITFA. Results from these studies revealed an indistinguishable difference in neurite outgrowth between the treatment and control groups, exhibiting that neurite outgrowth in response to G-1 and CITFA originates from GPER activation and can be abolished with pretreatment of an antagonist. Subsequent docking studies using a homology model of GPER showed unique docking poses between G-1 and CIFTA. While docking poses differed between the ligands, CIFTA exhibited more favorable distance, bond angle, and strain for hydrogen-bonding and hydrophobic interactions.
abstract_zh: 大量研究报道了雌激素具有神经保护和促认知作用。雌激素17β-雌二醇（E2）激活经典核雌激素受体ERα和ERβ，以及G蛋白偶联雌激素受体（GPER）。靶向经典雌激素受体与GPER的差异效应尚未被充分理解。目前描述的选择性GPER化合物数量有限。在本研究中，合成了10种新型化合物，并在非贴壁HL-60细胞中进行的钙动员实验中，其半数最大有效浓度值高于已知的GPER激动剂G-1。在这些化合物中，2-环己基-4-异丙基-N-((5-(四氢-2H-吡喃-2-基)呋喃-2-基)甲基)苯胺，简称CITFA，显著增加了从胚胎第18天（E18）胎鼠海马神经元中提取的神经元的轴突和树突生长。通过用已知的GPER选择性拮抗剂G-36处理E18海马神经元，并分别用E2、G-1或CITFA进行挑战，确认了实验结果。这些研究的结果显示，处理组和对照组之间的神经突生长无显著差异，表明响应G-1和CITFA的神经突生长源于GPER激活，并且可以通过拮抗剂预处理来消除。随后使用GPER同源模型进行的对接研究显示，G-1和CITFA之间具有独特的对接姿态。虽然配体之间的对接姿态不同，但CITFA在氢键和疏水相互作用方面表现出更有利的距离、键角和应变。
